rule: Crop the single large square nested figure out of the grid. Rotate each colour's cells inside the box clockwise about the box centre by a number of quarter turns. That number is the cell count of the loose legend piece of the same colour. Colours with no legend piece stay in place.
scope: Fresh square nested colour figures cropped from 1..30 input grids; each colour mask rotates by its legend polyomino count modulo four. Disjoint depth bands prevent layer collisions. Supports 1..9-cell legends including full cycles, absent legends, real periodic dash styles and optional four-way-distinguishable rotations.

authored_scope: Supported: background 0; square figure boxes (8..13 by default, or explicit 3..24); 1..9 layers (2..4 by default), each confined to its own band of Chebyshev ring depths; frame-with-bumps, checkerboard, dashed and dense layer styles; legend pieces that are random orthogonal polyominoes of 1..9 cells, excluding multiples of 4 (1, 2, 3 or 5 by default); colours without legend pieces; independent grid height and width (max(16, n+5)..24 by default, up to 30 when explicit; sizes other than 20x20 are synthetic extensions); explicit top/left placement; fixture replay from figure + legend cells. Deliberately not supported: non-square figures, which a quarter turn cannot map onto themselves; legend pieces whose size is a multiple of 4, which are indistinguishable from no piece; legend colours absent from the figure; layers whose rotations would interpenetrate other layers; non-zero backgrounds.
authored_constraints: Figure bounding box is exactly n x n: the first and last rows and columns each contain a figure cell.
Figure cells form a single cluster under 8-connectivity with merging at Chebyshev distance <= 2.
Every requested layer colour appears in the figure, and each colour occupies a disjoint contiguous band of ring depths, so rotations never collide.
At most one legend piece per colour; legend colours are figure colours; legend sizes are never multiples of 4.
Legend pieces lie at Chebyshev distance >= 3 from the figure box and are not 8-adjacent to each other.
Figure cell count exceeds the total legend cells + 5, so the figure is always the largest cluster.
At least one rotated layer actually changes under its rotation (no identity-only crop).
Background 0 is strictly the most frequent colour in the input.
Incompatible explicit parameters (size vs width/height, num_layers vs colors, legend_sizes without colors, replay plus random controls) raise ValueError.
